newsitem.title: USA: Computer Network looks for record revenue.
newsitem.headline: Computer Network looks for record revenue.

text.p: Computer Network Technology Corp said Wednesday it was confident 1996 will be a record revenue year.

"Historically, the third quarter has been challenging for Computer Netowork Technology," said president Tom Hudson in a statement. "This year we announced good growth in the level of revenue and orders in the third quarter, and a continuation of the sales momentum we saw in our record first half. We are confident 1996 will be a record revenue year."
Earlier Wednesday, the company reported third-quarter revenues rose to $24 million from $16.6 million a year ago.
Computer Network Technology develops high-performance networking products.
